title: Loop de Cay
description: Additive overdub loop with level decay
text:
Clocked overdub loop: play while armed to capture; each wrap applies Alt
strength through the selected Decay Mode (0 = freeze forever). Pitch modes stay
on the global scale. Random jitters scale pitch and only lowers velocity. Gate
shortens duration toward a 16th floor. Hold the button for long notes — mute is
Shift+Long. Hold+Fader glissandos through scale degrees toward the fader
(Chord Vamp–style). Length is Shift+Short (1–8 bars), not Alt/Third. Third picks
Decay Mode (Configurator sync). Quantized to 16ths.

### Cheatsheet

**Params / LEDs**

- Capture/playback hit: sharp button 80% dim (~2 PPQN) + Top white; layer meters on Top/Bottom/Button

channels.jackDescription: Depends on Mode (Pitch→MIDI / Gate→MIDI use CV In; MIDI→CV / Fader→Both use CV Out)
channels.faderDescription: Span around Base Note; quantized to global scale. Pitch→MIDI adds it to the CV pitch as a transpose
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Seven zones IR→UV (Btn+Fader; gate modes while muted)
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: 0 = immortal; higher ≈ fewer wraps to silence
channels.fnDescription: Hold for note in gate modes; Hold+Fader = glissando.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Shift + short = bars; Shift + long = mute/erase.
